card.name: Inside rare names and codes
card.fires_on: Responds to a piece in the middle or end of an unusual proper name, drug name or code, where the name is not yet finished. Examples are the end of a brand-name suffix like tislelizumab-js<<gr>> or a place or person name split into parts.

modes.label: Drug name endings
modes.description: Final pieces of newer drug names or gene names such as the -jsgr tag or EZH2.
modes.example: ZIIHERA in combination with fluoropyrimidine- and platinum-containing chemotherapy with or without tislelizumab-js<<gr>> Antidiarrheal prophylaxis

modes.label: Rare proper names
modes.description: Middle pieces of uncommon place, river or person names in general web text.
